attempts.summary: Deployed a Python stdlib inventory web app on node2 and node3 (systemd unit inventory-app.service, listening on 0.0.0.0:8080, serving /inventory and /healthz JSON). Configured nginx on node1 as an HTTP load balancer on port 80 with an upstream block round-robining across node2:8080 and node3:8080, verified round-robin distribution. Then completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes using sudo reboot, proving each node's boot_id changed and that services/load-balancing recovered after each restart, with the LB remaining continuously available throughout backend restarts.
